roles.developer: may freeze candidates and provide executables but may not see the protected corpus before disclosure
roles.custodian: controls corpus creation, storage, disclosure timing, and corpus identity
roles.evaluator: executes the frozen candidate against the disclosed corpus and produces raw and normalized artifacts
roles.release_authority: reviews evidence but cannot retroactively alter corpus, evaluator, or candidate identities

prohibitions: public development inputs cannot be relabeled as holdout
missing custody records cannot become PASS
organizational independence cannot be inferred from separate software processes
